text:
Samir Patel: FYI scheduling an overnight change window 00:30-01:30 UTC tonight to apply edge gateway routing + IAM tweaks for release v1.9.2. Plan: terraform plan -> eu-west-1 canary -> roll remaining AZs. Will pin aws provider to avoid drift bug. Any blockers?

Maya Li: Ack. I'll run a dry-run plan and paste the diff here. Recommend lockfile + provider pin.

Alex Chen: Put a repo freeze at 23:50 UTC (no merges). I'll prepare the deploybot job, set surge capacity to 0 and disable autoscale during the window.

infra-deploy-bot: deploybot: run created (id: 98765) scheduled for 2026-03-20 00:30 UTC. Preflight checks: ok. Plan pending manual approval.

Samir Patel: Who can own manual approval at 00:30? Jenna or Sylvia?

Jenna Ortiz: I can approve. I'll be on-call and available. Add me as approver on the run.

Maya Li: Dry-run plan (excerpt):
```
# aws_route.gateway_main will be updated in-place
+ resource "aws_route" "gateway_main" {
    destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
    gateway_id            = "igw-xyz"
    # changed: priority 100 -> 90 (route priority adjustment)
  }

# aws_iam_role.edge_assume_role will add a condition (no recreation expected)
```
No destroys expected. Small IAM policy condition added (needs review).

Alex Chen: If plan touches default routes we only canary eu-west-1. If KMS/role ARN changes, we freeze and escalate. Provider pin to add in versions.tf: `required_providers { aws = { version = "~> 4.2.0" } }` and run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64` before plan. Also snapshot state backup in S3 (done).

Samir Patel: Release notes draft (snippet):
- edge gateway: adjusted route priority to prefer nat-gateway for outbound flows
- IAM: tightened assume-role condition for service account used by auth-proxy
Rollback steps:
1) revert commit 9f8b2d4 (infra/edge-gateway)
2) re-run terraform apply against current state with previous workspace
3) notify on-call and tag deploybot with `rollback` label

infra-deploy-bot: deploybot: run 98765 awaiting approval (approver: Jenna Ortiz).

Jenna Ortiz: Approved.

infra-deploy-bot: deploybot: plan succeeded (changes: 4 to apply, 0 destroy). Apply queued.

Samir Patel: Starting canary in eu-west-1 now. Sylvia, please watch latency and route metrics for the next 10m.

Sylvia Ng: Watching canary dashboard (observability pinned). Will ping on any >10ms increase or error spike.

infra-deploy-bot: deploybot: apply started (run: 98765).

infra-deploy-bot: canary complete: eu-west-1 healthy after 5m. Proceeding to full rollout across AZs.

infra-deploy-bot: apply complete: success. total changes applied: 4. Tagged release: v1.9.2-deploy-1765439999.

Samir Patel: Nice. No regressions observed in the next 15m. Unfreeze repo at 01:40 UTC. I'll post release notes in #announcements and add the steps to the ops runbook.

Alex Chen: :thumbsup: I'll update the runbook with the provider pin snippet and the rollback checklist. Good job everyone.

Maya Li: Logging the plan diff and lockfile artifact under build/terraform/locks/1765439999-lock.hcl for audit.

Samir Patel: Closing thread. If anything crops up, reopen or ping me directly.
